name: Kuuta
source:
Age: Unknown.
Hobbies: Napping.
Special skills: None.
Likes: Warm places, places with a good flow of sound, ice cream.
Hates: Thunder.

Despite being unemployed, Kuuta seems not to be troubled with money. He is a quiet and non-talkative guy. He has an elegant appearance, but has no touch with  reality. Kuuta likes sitting alone in cafés and has the nature of a dog.

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/your_psp/chara_kuta.html]the official site (PSP edition)[/url].]
